name: screenpost
description: Control ScreenPost, the macOS screenshot and screen recording app, from your agent: capture, annotate, redact, export, share, and draft X posts behind a native approval sheet.
long_description: ScreenPost is a paid native macOS app (Apple Silicon, macOS 14+, $29 once, free 7-day trial). This bundle is a small launcher that connects your MCP client to the helper inside the installed app. Install ScreenPost from https://screenpost.app, then turn on Settings > Agents > Allow agents to control ScreenPost. Posting to X and scheduling always require approval in the app.
